h: The Showbread Reveals the Enduring Holiness of Yisrael

p: "On the day of Shabbos, on the day of Shabbos
יַעַרְכֶנּוּ לִפְנֵי ה׳ תָּמִיד וְגוֹ׳ (וַיִּקְרָא כד, ח)
he shall arrange it before Hashem continually, etc." (Vayikra 24:8).
It says "on the day of Shabbos" twice;
and this is because the three Shabbos meals
corresponding to the twelve tribes of God,
it is for the number of the tribes.
And with the tribes is mentioned
"And slaughter an animal and prepare it,"
הָיָה אָז מוּכָן לְכָל אֶחָד לֶחֶם אֶחָד
there was then prepared for each one a loaf,
so that there were twelve loaves;
and corresponding to them, the twelve loaves of the Showbread.
And this is what it says,
and it is in the manner of what they said
the covenant of the first ones,
for we have a tradition that no tribe will perish
that is, the covenant of Klal Yisrael,
so too each and every tribe
has a holiness of its own,
and the holiness will always remain.
and it is expounded (in Midrash Rabbah, Bereishis 99:4)
that afterward he included them all;
includes the holiness of every tribe,
And this is what it says,
"On the day of Shabbos, on the day of Shabbos
he shall arrange it before Hashem":
for they arranged the bread on the Table
at the time of the feast of Atika Kadisha,
which is learned from the second "today";
during the time of two Shabbos meals,
וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִשְׁאַר מוּנָּח עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן
and afterward it remained lying on the Table
and Yisrael sanctified Shabbos from their side
which is that of the Field of Apples,
וְזֶה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם
and this is "from Bnei Yisrael, an eternal covenant."
And it was eaten on the second Shabbos day,
גַּם כֵּן בִּזְמַן סְעוּדָתָא דְּעַתִּיקָא קַדִּישָׁא
again at the time of the feast of Atika Kadisha.
וְעַל זֶה יִסֵּד הָאֲרִ״י זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
And about this the Arizal, of blessed memory, composed
"May He reveal to us the reasons
the revelation of reasons and secrets,
and the vitality of the holiness in them.
that of the Table, David merited and took it"
which alludes to the crown of kingship.
on the Table that is before Hashem,
drew down bounty for Klal Yisrael;
as is written in the holy Zohar
to set the table on Shabbos
that it not be an empty table,
and "Out of the north comes gold" (Iyov 37:22);
"One who wishes to become wealthy should face north."
That is: the king of Yisrael,
because of the greatness of the fear
as they said in the Gemara (Berachos 3b)
regarding David HaMelech, peace be upon him:
"The Sages of Yisrael came in to him, etc.:
Your people Yisrael need sustenance, etc."
And likewise of Shlomo HaMelech, peace be upon him,
eating and drinking and rejoicing, etc.";
for he drew great bounty for them,
that the yetzer hara rules only
of the twelve loaves of the Showbread:
so that the yetzer hara not rule
And on Shabbos they placed the Showbread
וְהָיָה מוּנָּח כָּל שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה
and it lay there all six workdays,
in order to draw the holiness
until the night meal had passed over it,
which is the feast of the Field of Apples,
which is the holiness of Knesses Yisrael,

p: And next to this section is placed
and it is stated in Rashi's commentary,
"He went out from the section above:
'Is it the way of a king to eat warm bread
"He took the heh of the holy Name
in the Gemara (Yoma 21a) it is stated:
its removal was like its arrangement,
on the day it was taken'";
and he did not believe in this miracle.
for according to the one who holds
that it does not override Shabbos,
at the time of its arrangement either.
that according to the one who holds
that it was baked on Shabbos eve,
בְּחָל שְׁנֵי יָמִים טוֹבִים שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה
when the two days of Rosh Hashanah fall
and it is impossible to keep its warmth
And it is possible that in truth a miracle was performed
at its arrangement too, that it was warm.
for then it was for the sake of the main mitzvah,
which are called "My bread, for My fire-offerings":
for He spoke and His will was done.
but it simply lay there by itself
until the next Shabbos was sanctified
and there was the feast of the Field of Apples,
at its removal as at its arrangement
from the holiness of Knesses Yisrael.
And this is what they said in the Gemara (Yoma 21b),
that they would raise it up for the pilgrims
"See how beloved you are before the Omnipresent:
its removal is like its arrangement."
And why was this miracle mentioned specifically?
And why did they not show them
the miracle performed with the western lamp,
and with which he would conclude,
that the Shechinah rests upon Yisrael"?
But regarding this one may say
that there might be someone who does not believe
that oil was put into it
in the same measure as its fellows;
they would raise it to show them
that this is the bread being distributed,
and afterward they saw it in the hands of the Kohanim,
that it is warm bread as at its arrangement.
וְזֶה הָיָה יוֹדֵעַ כָּל אֶחָד בְּעַצְמוֹ
this each one knew for himself,
וְטְפֵי הֲוָה לֵיהּ לְהַזְכִּיר נֵס זֶה
and it would have been more fitting to mention this miracle:
that they mentioned with the Showbread
was that it was warm even on the next Shabbos,
שֶׁהָיָה מוּנָּח כָּל שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה
until the entry of Shabbos had passed over it,
the feast of the Field of Apples,
and the miracle performed with it
And this is "See how beloved you are before the Omnipresent."
And also the impurity that the Table had
to show it to the pilgrims
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא חֲגִיגָה שָׁם, כו, ב)
(as they said in the Gemara, Chagigah 26b)
is likewise in the manner of
what I heard of the episode
that happened with our holy master,
הָרַבִּי מִלּוּבְּלִין זֵכֶר צַדִּיק וְקָדוֹשׁ לִבְרָכָה
and when he looked into the cup
he said that it is kosher,
but he does not see in it
וְעַל כֵּן לֹא רָצָה לְקַדֵּשׁ עָלָיו
and therefore he did not want to make Kiddush over it.
And about this our holy master said,
that in a thing in which there is found
in that thing there is the brightness of holiness;
and in a thing in which there is no opposite,
there is also no brightness of the kosher;
"The bones of a donkey are pure,
and the bones of Yochanan the Kohen Gadol are impure"
"according to their belovedness is their impurity."
the Table became susceptible to impurity
for among the nations there is no
and it is all only in Yisrael,
and therefore here it is called
did not believe in the holiness of Knesses Yisrael,
for he was born of an Egyptian
and he was born of that filth,
as is written in the holy Zohar
"Whoever is of the filth of the seed, etc.,
the filth of the evil portion that is in him,
he denied the holiness of Yisrael,
and said: What difference does it make
that he was born of an Egyptian?
And this is why he denied
the miracle performed with the Showbread
which shows the holiness of Knesses Yisrael,
"See how beloved you are before the Omnipresent,"
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar:
"He took the heh of the holy Name and cursed":
that he denied the holiness of Knesses Yisrael,
and this is what it says,
And on Shabbos one sets out twelve loaves
of the holiness of all twelve tribes.
